episode_summary: In this episode, D.J. Paris and Tim Littleton discuss the challenges buyer's agents face in a low inventory market, where 72% of buyers find homes without an agent. They introduce the Four Doors System, a strategy to access off-market properties, enhancing client service and securing more deals. The episode emphasizes proactive engagement to maintain client relationships and create inventory.
